description: Shell script for testing 'git rerere' functionality, including setup, conflict resolution, diff, status, garbage collection, and various edge cases.

methods.name: concat_insert
methods.description: Concatenates predefined 'early' and 'late' content with specified last argument, used for creating conflict files.

methods.name: count_pre_post
methods.description: Counts the number of 'preimage' and 'postimage' files in the rerere cache directory.

methods.name: merge_conflict_resolve
methods.description: Simulates a merge conflict resolution by resetting and creating specific conflict files.
